Caring for Horses - Mind, Body & Soul.

The Bergen County Horse Rescue, founded in 2016, strives to provide a safe, loving environment for our horses so they can freely interact with each other in their herds, as well as with our volunteers and with visitors to the farm. BCHR is dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of abused, abandoned and neglected horses.
